verdict.rationale: llamafile runs entirely on the user's own device with no cloud calls and no outbound networking, meaning all data (including uploaded images) stays wherever the user chooses to run the executable — the strongest form of residency control. This is corroborated by community testing showing zero network connections during use. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation framing this as 'data residency/region selection' or any enterprise-style residency controls beyond 'runs on your own machine'.
